description: Defines the CustomShippingQuotesRegion class, representing a custom shipping region with properties such as region name, associated countries, and quote items, along with a method for serializing the object to a JSON string.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesRegion
classes.description: Represents a custom shipping region with a name, list of countries, and quote items, and provides JSON serialization functionality.

methods.name: setQuoteItems
methods.description: Sets the list of quote items for the region.

methods.name: getQuoteItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of quote items.

methods.name: setCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of country codes associated with this region.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Gets the list of country codes.

methods.name: setCustomRegionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the custom region.

methods.name: getCustomRegionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the custom region.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON string representation.
